meta.title: AI paid media tools
meta.description: An evidence-backed comparison of MCP servers, advertising APIs, plugins and command-line tools for paid-media operations, analytics and measurement.
meta.scope: Tools that can materially support planning, buying, measuring, modelling, moving data, automating work or producing paid-media creative.

tools.name: Google Ads
tools.summary: Read campaign structure, metrics and GAQL reports. Create assets and manage labels, not campaigns or budgets.

mcp.label: Google Ads official MCP, local or self-deployed

developer.label: Google Ads API and client libraries

tools.access: Production API access requires approved Cloud project access. Developer tokens sunset 9 September 2026.
tools.caution: Campaign changes still require another route; video upload is local only.

tools.name: Meta Ads
tools.summary: Prior review covered campaign structure and performance. Current connector writes remain unverified.
tools.access: Prior record: open beta. Current announcement redirects to login; developer pages return 429 or inaccessible.
tools.caution: Official pages were inaccessible; keep the previous grade visibly pending.

tools.name: TikTok for Business
tools.summary: Read campaign information, reports and audience context. Create campaigns and change budgets, bids and targeting.

mcp.label: TikTok for Business official hosted MCP

tools.access: TikTok for Business account and authorised permissions; vendor describes production-ready support.
tools.caution: Exact deletion and launch tools remain unverified.

tools.name: Microsoft Advertising
tools.summary: Read campaigns, keywords, assets, reports and change history. Read-only; apply changes in another tool.
tools.access: Existing Advertising account permissions; personal and work/school Microsoft accounts supported.
tools.caution: Hosted does not mean one-click: ChatGPT and Claude need an Entra app registration.

tools.name: Amazon Ads
tools.summary: Read performance, account and billing information. Create, update and delete supported campaigns.
tools.access: Globally available open beta to Amazon Ads partners with active API credentials.
tools.caution: Open beta with partner/API access; not every ad product is covered.

tools.name: Snapchat Ads
tools.summary: Read authorised campaign setup and performance. Read-only; campaign writes are not released.
tools.access: No allowlist. Organisation Admin/Business Admin first approves each agent; each member then authorises their own existing access.
tools.caution: Self-service access still requires organisation approval and member consent.

tools.name: LinkedIn Ads
tools.summary: Read campaign configuration and performance through approved APIs. Create and manage campaigns through custom API code.
tools.access: r_ads/rw_ads scopes and account roles; Viewer remains read-only even with rw_ads.
tools.caution: No ready official agent connector verified; use a supported API version.

tools.name: Pinterest Ads
tools.summary: Read campaigns, ad groups and performance. Create and manage campaigns, ad groups and ads via API.
tools.access: Business Access, supported advertising country, billing and advertising agreement; some onboarding remains in Pinterest UI.
tools.caution: Custom integration required; some fields become immutable after draft.

tools.name: Reddit Ads
tools.summary: Read campaign information and reports through API v3. Create campaigns and audiences; modify supported settings.
tools.access: App creation is business-admin-only; existing authorisation and Ads API terms apply.
tools.caution: Exact deletion and activation coverage remains unverified.

tools.name: X Ads
tools.summary: Read campaign structure, analytics, audiences and creative assets. Build and edit campaigns, then activate them explicitly.
tools.access: Existing ad account access; ads.read/ads.write and optional media.write scopes.
tools.caution: Developer-app OAuth setup remains; selected deletes exclude campaign deletion.

tools.name: Display & Video 360
tools.summary: Read trafficking resources; use a separate route for performance reports. Manage supported resources, including responsive YouTube ads in v5 beta.
tools.access: DV360 permissions apply. v5 is labelled beta in current reference.
tools.caution: Custom API work remains; the YouTube update does not cover every format.

tools.name: Campaign Manager 360
tools.summary: Read campaign resources and reports via API v5. Create campaigns and reports; update supported campaign fields.
tools.access: Existing CM360 user-profile permissions control API access.
tools.caution: A custom trafficking integration is needed; archive is not deletion.

tools.name: Search Ads 360
tools.summary: Query campaign-to-keyword resources and performance reports. The evaluated Reporting API is read-only.
tools.access: Authorised Search Ads 360 account access.
tools.caution: Custom setup still stops at diagnosis; campaign changes happen elsewhere.

tools.name: Apple Ads
tools.summary: Read reports and authorised campaign configuration. Create and manage supported campaigns, ad groups and keywords.
tools.access: Read-only, read/write and limited-account roles are separate.
tools.caution: No ready official AI connector verified; exact delete and activation tools remain unverified.

tools.name: The Trade Desk
tools.summary: Platform data access is announced; exact tools remain unverified. Current OAK action inventory remains unverified.

plugin.label: No separate official agent plugin verified

tools.access: Private beta from 10 August 2026. Current public search excerpt still says selected partners only.
tools.caution: Private beta and inaccessible tool evidence; keep the previous grade pending.

tools.name: Google Analytics
tools.summary: Read properties, dimensions, key events and analytics reports. Create annotations, custom dimensions and key events with writes enabled.

mcp.label: Google Analytics official MCP, local or self-deployed

cli.label: Package launcher only; no analytics CLI

tools.access: Read access follows Analytics account permissions. Writes default off; require --allow-write plus analytics.edit. Custom dimensions require Editor; key events require Marketer or Editor.
tools.caution: Three creation tools do not provide general property administration or tracking implementation.

tools.name: Google Tag Manager
tools.summary: Read accounts, containers, workspaces, tags and versions. Change configuration, create previews and publish container versions.
tools.access: Google account must have the relevant GTM permissions, particularly publish rights. Hosted traffic passes through Stape; local CLI is an alternative. AI workspace policy can restrict custom connectors.
tools.caution: Stape is a third party; publication does not verify tracking or consent. Commercial limits remain unverified.

tools.name: Amplitude
tools.summary: Query analytics and inspect charts, cohorts, experiments and taxonomy. Create and edit analytical content and tracking definitions.
tools.access: Existing customers, including free Starter, can use MCP. Write actions require Use MCP (write) plus product permissions. Service-account authentication requires Enterprise.
tools.caution: Guides/surveys stop at drafts; definition changes do not ingest production events.

tools.name: Mixpanel
tools.summary: Read events, funnels, retention, saved reports and data-quality issues. Manage dashboards and cohorts; update definitions and resolve data issues.
tools.access: Existing project roles apply. New Free/Growth accounts after 1 August 2026 have MCP enabled by default; other accounts require an organisation admin. Free query limits apply. Audit-log queries need organisation admin/owner.
tools.caution: US has direct connectors; EU/India use custom connectors. Experiment targeting is unavailable.

tools.name: Supermetrics
tools.summary: Read connected marketing accounts, fields and cross-channel performance. Create paused campaigns and edit supported budgets, ads and settings.
tools.access: AI chats or MCP entitlement/trial, Campaign management entitlement and seat where applicable, connected accounts with platform edit permission. The connection owner enables writes for each account/team.
tools.caution: Writes require account-level opt-in and entitlement; coverage varies across seven ad platforms.

tools.name: DataForSEO
tools.summary: Retrieve SERP, keyword, backlink and competitor research data. Submit billable research tasks; no campaign or website mutations.

cli.label: Official CLI in the MCP package

tools.access: DataForSEO account, API access and funding/entitlement for the requested endpoint; compatible remote MCP client.
tools.caution: Research execution is not campaign control; API endpoint costs and allowances apply.

tools.name: Airbyte
tools.summary: Read connector configuration, sync status, logs and supported external records. Manage connectors and pipelines; start or cancel syncs.

plugin.label: No separate official agent plugin verified

tools.access: Hosted MCP supports Airbyte Cloud editions and Flex. Direct reads/search require Cloud and supported connectors. Airbyte roles and stored connector credentials govern access.
tools.caution: External source/destination records remain read-only; infrastructure and credentials must already exist.

tools.name: Fivetran
tools.summary: Query the prepared warehouse context layer with read-only SQL. Submit answer feedback only; no operational data changes.
tools.access: Public Preview. Fivetran/admin access, an organisation context layer, permitted users and AI-workspace administration for initial setup. Query-role options depend on warehouse.
tools.caution: Public Preview; the native connector still needs an administrator-prepared context layer.

tools.name: Google MCP Toolbox for Databases
tools.summary: Query configured databases and inspect their schemas. Execute only the database operations exposed by your toolset.

mcp.label: Google MCP Toolbox, self-managed database tools

tools.access: Open-source server plus a supported database/cloud account, credentials, network access and operation-level permissions.
tools.caution: Hosting, credentials and tool design remain your responsibility; read-only behaviour varies by engine.

tools.name: Snowflake
tools.summary: Query governed data through configured SQL and Cortex tools. Optional SQL and custom tools can change data when explicitly enabled.
tools.access: Snowflake account, warehouse/data, configured semantic views/search/agents as relevant, and separate permissions for both server and underlying tools.
tools.caution: SQL defaults to read-only; hosting is managed but tool and data preparation is technical.

tools.name: Meridian
tools.summary: Inspect prepared data, model results and convergence diagnostics. Run modelling scripts and produce saved models and budget scenarios.

cli.label: Python package, not a dedicated CLI

tools.access: Open-source skills/library, compatible coding agent, Python dependencies and appropriate compute; specialist judgement for priors, data and model validation.
tools.caution: Official agent skills still require local Python, historical data and specialist validation.

tools.name: Robyn
tools.summary: Read prepared historical data and inspect model outputs through code. Fit models and generate diagnostics and allocation scenarios.

cli.label: R and Python package, not a dedicated CLI

tools.access: Open-source packages and suitable compute; modelling skills and prepared data required.
tools.caution: Specialist coding setup; no ready official external-agent connector verified.

tools.name: PyMC-Marketing
tools.summary: Read prepared data and fitted Bayesian models through Python. Create models, diagnostics, forecasts and allocation scenarios.

cli.label: Python package, not a dedicated CLI

tools.access: Open-source library, compatible Python environment and compute. Separate hosted products have their own accounts and access requirements.
tools.caution: Simba MCP is a separate product; its hosted capabilities do not belong to this library entry.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.summary: Read and search records in connected apps. Run supported app actions; workflow creation is separate early access.

plugin.label: MCP tool bundles, not a separate plugin

tools.access: Zapier account, connected app permissions and applicable task allowance.
tools.caution: Coverage depends on each app; Next Gen Zaps deployment is not available to every account.

tools.name: Pipedream
tools.summary: Search and retrieve records from connected apps. Create and update app records through hosted actions.

plugin.label: No separate official agent plugin verified

tools.access: Pipedream account, connected app authorisation, usage and downstream permissions.
tools.caution: Each app has its own tools; app actions do not establish Pipedream workflow authoring.

tools.name: n8n
tools.summary: Read exposed workflows, executions and supported data tables. Create, edit, test, publish and unpublish workflows.

plugin.label: Native nodes and skills, not a separate plugin

tools.access: Suitable n8n version, instance permissions and connected-service credentials. Authoring is documented from 2.13.0; individual tools have version gates.
tools.caution: Credentials and admin setup remain; protected instances restrict mutations.

tools.name: Figma
tools.summary: Read design structure, components, variables and file context. Create and edit native canvas objects in supported clients.

cli.label: No dedicated official Figma CLI verified

tools.access: Supported client, file edit access and eligible Figma plan; Full seat required outside Drafts. Canvas writing is free during beta, with future usage pricing announced.
tools.caution: Canvas writing is beta; library publishing stays manual and visual review remains necessary.

tools.name: Canva
tools.summary: Read designs, pages, content, folders and permitted brand templates. Create and edit designs, transform images and export assets.
tools.access: AI Connector available to Free and paid accounts, subject to admin controls. Brand templates/autofill/resize and export quality have plan restrictions; AI allowances apply.
tools.caution: Premium licensing and tool limits apply; general deletion and social publishing are not established.

tools.name: Adobe Analytics
tools.summary: Read reports, components, date ranges and workspace projects. Create or update segments, calculated metrics and projects.

cli.label: No dedicated official analytics CLI verified

tools.access: Requires Adobe Analytics access and MCP Read-only Access or MCP Full Access. Writes require Full Access plus normal component permissions. Product admins automatically have Full Access.
tools.caution: No delete tool is listed; component writes do not configure collection tags.

tools.name: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
tools.summary: Read data views, components, audiences, projects and reports. Create or update analytical components, projects and audiences.

cli.label: No dedicated official CJA CLI verified

tools.access: CJA entitlement, relevant data-view/component permissions and MCP Read-only or Full Access. Writes require Full Access and underlying action permissions; product admins automatically receive Full Access.
tools.caution: No general deletion or connection administration; audience creation does not prove downstream activation.

tools.name: PostHog
tools.summary: Read analytics, SQL/schema, insights, errors and pipeline diagnostics. Manage dashboards, insights, flags, experiments and supported pipelines.
tools.access: Existing project access and authorised scopes apply. MCP connection/calls are free; some tools using LLMs internally require organisation AI data processing enabled and can incur PostHog AI spend.
tools.caution: Events must already be collected; some AI tools can incur additional usage costs.

tools.name: AppsFlyer
tools.summary: Read aggregate performance, creative, SKAN and configuration data. Create OneLink short links under existing templates, with confirmation.
tools.access: Beta; existing AppsFlyer permissions apply. MCP is enabled by default but an admin can disable it. Account-level bearer tokens are available for automation.
tools.caution: Beta: ten links per account per day; no wider account-editing MCP tools documented.

tools.name: Adjust
tools.summary: Read aggregate Adjust performance data. No Adjust account mutations are documented for this MCP.
tools.access: Early Access and account enablement required. Existing token-based configurations must reconnect through OAuth. Multi-account users select the account during authorisation.
tools.caution: Early Access requires enablement; no user-level or event-level data.

tools.name: Twilio Segment
tools.summary: Read workspace sources, destinations, warehouses and tracking plans through API. Manage supported workspace resources through a custom API integration.

mcp.label: Documentation MCP only; account route uses the API

cli.label: No general official workspace CLI verified

tools.access: Public API is available to Team and Business tiers; only Workspace Owners can create tokens, assigning owner/member access. US and EU workspaces are supported.
tools.caution: Twilio docs MCP only retrieves documentation; it cannot access or change the account.

tools.name: Adobe Firefly Creative Production
tools.summary: Discover actions/templates, check run status and retrieve outputs. Compose creative workflows, transform media and publish reusable workflows.

plugin.label: No separate official agent plugin verified

tools.access: Organisation service access and admin-provided credentials; availability must be checked for the customer organisation.
tools.caution: Organisation credentials are required; output links expire and publishing does not distribute ads.

tools.name: Runway
tools.summary: Retrieve generated outputs; general library search is unverified. Generate images/videos and perform supported reference-based transformations.
tools.access: Runway account; eligible models and generation costs depend on plan and Runway credits.
tools.caution: Do not borrow Runway Dev tools or archived server capabilities into the generation app.

tools.name: Ahrefs
tools.summary: Retrieve keyword, backlink, domain and SEO research reports. No operational content or account writes established.
tools.access: Lite plan or higher, monthly API units and per-request row limits.
tools.caution: Strong research access does not edit websites; plan and API-unit allowances apply.

tools.name: Semrush
tools.summary: Read SEO, Trends and supported Projects reports. Read-only; project creation and settings changes are excluded.

cli.label: No dedicated official Semrush CLI verified

tools.access: Appropriate Semrush API subscription and units; Trends coverage follows subscription level.
tools.caution: MCP does not inherit wider REST API mutations; API units and subscribed datasets apply.

tools.name: Similarweb
tools.summary: Read website/app, audience, traffic, search and commerce intelligence. No account, campaign or content writes established.
tools.access: API-only, Business or Enterprise subscription with API/MCP access. Data credits apply; plan limits datasets, regions and historical ranges.
tools.caution: The connector exposes subscribed datasets only and consumes data credits.

tools.name: RudderStack
tools.summary: Read exposed sources, destinations, transformations and event context. Manage supported configuration; exact CRUD tools are not fully documented.

plugin.label: No separate official agent plugin verified

tools.access: Active RudderStack account with relevant permissions; team connector setup may require an administrator.
tools.caution: Active development and incomplete public action coverage; verify the actual tool inventory.

tools.name: Databricks
tools.summary: Query governed analytics with Genie One or use the separate SQL MCP. SQL MCP can change data within warehouse and Unity Catalog permissions.

mcp.label: Databricks Genie One + separate SQL MCP

plugin.label: No separate official paid-media plugin verified

tools.access: Databricks workspace and resource privileges. Genie One MCP is GA; SQL MCP requires an account admin to enable Enhanced Unity Gateway preview and is Beta.
tools.caution: Genie One is GA; SQL writes use a separate Beta route requiring admin enablement.

tools.name: dbt
tools.summary: Read metrics, model context, lineage, freshness, jobs and SQL results. Trigger, retry or cancel jobs; execute SQL with development credentials.

mcp.label: dbt remote MCP, excluding local CLI

plugin.label: No separate official paid-media plugin verified

tools.access: Remote MCP is available across dbt platform plans but underlying API tools vary by plan. OAuth is public beta for Starter, Enterprise and Enterprise+. Token-based execute_sql needs a personal token, not a service token.
tools.caution: Remote MCP does not run local project commands; SQL write rights follow development credentials.

tools.name: Make
tools.summary: Read authorised scenarios, connections, teams and organisation context. Modify supported automation assets and run authorised scenarios.

plugin.label: No separate official agent plugin verified

tools.access: Scenario-run tools on all plans; management tools on paid plans, with appropriate scopes and downstream connections.
tools.caution: Paid management scopes differ from scenario execution; exact create/delete/activation tools need checking.

tools.name: Workato
tools.summary: Read permitted projects, folders, connections, jobs and workspace assets. Manage role-enabled workspace resources and exposed business tools.

plugin.label: No separate official agent plugin verified

tools.access: Workato organisation access and project/endpoint permissions. Embedded API needs Embedded-admin token; vendor says MCP unavailable in CN despite a CN URL appearing in its table.
tools.caution: Enterprise administration and scoped API roles remain; no universal recipe deployment claim.

tools.name: Gumloop
tools.summary: Read agents, sessions, artifacts, tools, flows and permitted knowledge sources. Create and edit agents/skills, run them and manage supported triggers.

plugin.label: No separate official agent plugin verified

tools.access: Gumloop account and appropriate personal/team scope. Several agent, evaluation, session and organisation operations require a personal API key.
tools.caution: Personal/team scopes differ; complete visual-flow authoring is not established.
